storyCards.headline: I'd Rather Be Blind: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Etta James's "I'd Rather Be Blind" — original release 1967. "I'd Rather Go Blind" is a blues song written by Ellington Jordan with co-writing credits to Billy Foster and Etta James.

Artist: Etta James · Title: I'd Rather Be Blind · Album: The Best Of Etta James · Year: 1968 · Genre: Jazz · PlayCount: 1 · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1960's/Etta James - I'd Rather Be Blind.mp4.

It was first recorded by Etta James in 1967, released the same year, and has subsequently become regarded as a blues and soul classic.

Original version by Etta James
Etta James wrote in her autobiography Rage To Survive that she heard the song outlined by her friend Ellington "Fugi" Jordan when she visited him in prison.
